name: Module Firmware
summary: Adversaries may install malicious or vulnerable firmware onto modular hardware devices. Control system devices often contain modular hardware devices. These devices may have their own set of firmware that is separate from the firmware of the main control system equipment. This technique is similar to System Firmware, but is conducted on other system components that may not have the same capabilities or level of integrity checking. Although it…

analytics.name: Analytic 1922
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a firmware write command targeting a specific Input/Output (I/O) module slot address within a controller chassis from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, distinguishing module-level firmware modification from main-processor firmware updates by its slot-addressed targeting. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect.
